paragraphs.text: golfella is a speedrunning platformer/golf game mashup. think sonic the hedgehog but you're juggling a golf ball- chaining moves and strokes into combos to try to finish each hole as quickly as possible with as few strokes as you can. i made the entire ost for this game, it's one of my favorite musical projects ever!

this was my first time scoring a video game, and i had a blast. i joined the team after the demo was already out, and they were actually looking to redo the music after their original musician left. i ended up completely rescoring the game from scratch.

the plan for golfella was to have five planets, each with their own music. i wanted to try my hand at doing a memorable main theme, and using each world to remix the theme in a new genre. the project sort of fizzled out after just two planets, so i ended up finishing three level themes plus a title song and a credit song- but i'm really happy with how they turned out!
